extras: The plugin is local-first, requiring no cloud service or account. Note that Obsidian Sync may not transfer the plugin files due to size.
intentEvidence: Inscriptum lets you create and edit rich documents without having to write Markdown.
motivation: The author built it to provide a local-first, private editing experience without cloud dependency or account lock-in.
problem: Users often find writing complex, structured documents using Markdown cumbersome and prefer a visual editing experience.
summary: A local-first WYSIWYG editor that allows users to create and edit rich, structured documents without needing to write Markdown.
